name: RP Kiki look
description: After Kiki's Delivery Service (1989): lifted soft blacks, low contrast, cool blue-grey mids and shadows under a faint cream in the highlights, cel greens pulled toward leaf green, skies azure, saturation a touch down. Our own numbers, measured from five stills; strength set at 130 percent of the first draft on Isaac's letter, 2026-11-07.
